title: Project Data Product Sibling Environments Manifest
description: Optional project-level declared catalog sibling environments (.loxtep/data-product-siblings.json). Prefer per-product sibling_environments[] on data-product entities; use this manifest to declare which logical products exist in which environments without editing every product file. Prefer environment_key. Same logical_key + different environment_key are sibling catalog products (new UUIDs). Deploy applies a matching declaration into data_products and fails closed when a declaring product omits the target env (no silent catalog sibling, no stage runtime-row copy).

logical_key.description: Stable logical key when data_product_id is omitted or for readability

sibling_environments.description: Environments in which this logical product exists as its own catalog row.

environment_key.description: Logical environment (stage, prod, dev, franchise slug, …). Preferred over hard-coded instance UUIDs.
